title: PitchShifter - dual-head granular buffer, double drift accumulator, 4-point Lagrange, Hann unity-gain crossfade
description:
Implement Source/DSP/PitchShifter only. One instance will later run at +detune and one at −detune.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/ShredWidth_Build_Spec.md §§4.2 (dual-head granular end-to-end math), 4.3 (Lagrange), 4.9 (Studio L=2048 / Live L=512), §6 (detune smoothing feeds dv), §7–§8
- risk_notes: double drift accumulator; all four Lagrange neighbors wrapped mod L

Implement class PitchShifter in Source/DSP/PitchShifter.h + PitchShifter.cpp:
1. API: prepare(sampleRate, maxBlock), reset(), setLatencyModeStudioOrLive / setBufferLength(L), setDetuneCents(float deltaC), processSample(float x)->float (optional block process).
2. Circular buffer length L: always allocate Studio L_max=2048 + ≥4 Lagrange guard in prepare; Live uses the first 512 samples only (no realloc on mode switch).
3. Write pointer advances one sample per sample.
4. Two read heads A/B offset by L/2 as delays behind the write pointer. Drift accumulator tau is double (NOT float): advance by dv = 1 - pow(2.0, deltaC/1200.0) each sample; branchless wrap: if (tau >= L) tau -= L; if (tau < 0) tau += L.
5. Fractional read: 4-point cubic Lagrange (§4.3). Each of y_{-1}, y_0, y_1, y_2 is read with individual wrap mod L.
6. Raised-cosine (Hann) crossfade from head position so w_A + w_B == 1 exactly (unity gain, no ripple): w = 0.5 * (1 - cos(2π * tau_head / L)); heads L/2 apart.
7. detuneAmount path: accept smoothed cents (caller may smooth); setDetuneCents may also keep juce::SmoothedValue ~20 ms feeding dv so zipper cannot pitch-glitch.
8. Nominal delay for docs/engine: L/2 samples (not implemented as host PDC here).
9. RT: no heap/locks/logs outside prepare; O(1) per sample.

Do not implement DelayLineFrac/crossover/width, tests, or CMakeLists. Do not wire into PluginProcessor.
acceptance_criteria: PitchShifter allocates L_max=2048 (+ Lagrange guard) in prepare and supports Live L=512 without reallocation
Drift accumulator tau is double and advances by dv = 1 - 2^(deltaC/1200) with branchless wrap
Dual read heads are offset by L/2 with Hann/raised-cosine weights satisfying w_A + w_B == 1
Fractional reads use 4-point cubic Lagrange with each neighbor individually wrapped mod L
prepare/process/reset API present; no allocation outside prepare
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify DelayLineFrac, MonoSafetyCrossover, WidthProcessor, PluginProcessor, PluginEditor
use float for the drift accumulator tau

allowed: hand-roll circular buffer and Lagrange inside PitchShifter
optional internal SmoothedValue on detune cents
enum or bool for Studio/Live active L
forbidden: report latency via setLatencySamples inside this class
